youtube.aciklama: In a large survey of deaf and hard of hearing students in the United States, about 40 percent were reported to have an additional disability. Prematurity, congenital infections, lack of oxygen at birth and syndromes can affect both hearing and development. An additional disability can delay recognition of hearing loss.
